function.name: Audio_SendSceneStateCommand
behavior: Selects the corresponding command word from LEVEL_TABLE at 0x00002C78 using the 0x42-byte scene entry stride.
Calls Audio_SendCommand only when SCENE_TRANSITION_EVENT at 0x00FFF57F is set.

conclusion: Scene-transition audio notification is selected from the canonical level table rather than from a separate hard-coded scene-state switch.
